name: Cover: Cobalt Grid
description: A trend-report cover: two hairlines frame the page top and bottom, a huge serif title top left with the series name and one serif lede, a pixel-stair scan column on the right, a vertical line of small occasion text at the far right, a source note bottom left and the page number bottom right. A plain title slide would lose the printed-journal feel that the scan column and the vertical small text give.

title.hint: claim headline, 2 lines, up to 16 characters; large serif type, *keyword* turns italic

brand.hint: series or deck name in small capitals, filled automatically from the series name of the story title (before the colon)

subtitle.hint: one serif lede, up to 50 characters

meta.hint: vertical small text for the occasion or date, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion (up to 10 characters)

cta.hint: source or author note bottom left, filled automatically from the first evidence entry

title.value: Our revision time goes on layout
